Method.Name: Command

Implementation.ST:
IF eControlSource <> E_ControlSource.PLC THEN F_SendMessage('Command not accepted due to wrong ControlSource', TcEventSeverity.Warning, THIS^.fbSourceInfo); Command := FALSE; RETURN; END_IF
// the request is checked (Enable, link, state) and latched in RequestCommand(), // evaluated (sequence, GVL write) in EvaluateCommand() of the next Run() cycle Command := RequestCommand(eCommand := eCommand, eSource := eSource, nTargetSlot := nTargetSlot, eRequiredTool := eRequiredTool, nMinPressDistanceUm := nMinPressDistanceUm, bThinPlate := bThinPlate, nCleanPosition := nCleanPosition, nCleanStepCount := nCleanStepCount, eOutputIndex := eOutputIndex, bOutputSet := bOutputSet, bServiceEnable := bServiceEnable, stProtocol := stProtocol, bToolFromExternal := bToolFromExternal, bOldToolToExternal := bOldToolToExternal, bUseExternalPutFallback := bUseExternalPutFallback);
